answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the anchor accrues. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra copper buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the gale behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal fopx1.
